title: Canonical module structure on a topological inverse image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map, $\mathcal R$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $Y$, and $\mathcal M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. On the inverse-image sheaf of abelian groups $f^{-1}\mathcal M$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image], give each section group its canonical $f^{-1}\mathcal R$-module structure: multiply local representatives on a common open before sheafification. Restrictions are semilinear. The unit $\eta_{\mathcal M}:\mathcal M\to f_*f^{-1}\mathcal M$ is semilinear over $\eta_{\mathcal R}$. For an $\mathcal R$-linear morphism $a$, the underlying inverse-image abelian sheaf map $f^{-1}a$ is $f^{-1}\mathcal R$-linear.
